purpose.statement: keep the task TUI calm, live, and glanceable.
purpose.why: The larger goal is Trustworthy task operations. The concrete problem is that operators cannot act confidently if snapshots rewind, active work disappears, or navigation fights the focused pane. Shipping forward-only snapshot handling, live lifecycle cues, focused scrolling, and regression gates is the correct intervention because forward-only snapshot acceptance repairs temporal truth, live cues expose real state changes, and focused input routing gives each pane predictable ownership. If omitted, the board becomes a noisy animation rather than an operational instrument.
